decisions.reason: As a close-to-core compliance tool with early positive agency feedback and likely low ongoing carrying cost, it is still a worthwhile option to keep open while demand becomes clearer.
Because it builds directly on the firm’s hosting business and was prominent on the home page, management would treat it as a strategic core option worth retaining while scaling and learning continue.

A configurable managed hosting plan fits the existing infrastructure and customer base, so with no clear negative signal yet it is cheaper to continue observing market response than to abandon it after only one year.
